messages.subject: [Bioc-sig-proteomics] bioc-sig-proteomics list going away
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Due to low usage, the bioc-sig-proteomics mailing list will be removed.

For continued support, you may subscribe to another Bioconductor mailing list:

http://bioconductor.org/help/mailing-list/

Thanks,
Dan
